info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Weather Alerts Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Status API provides real-time status information regarding weather alerts. It enables users to access critical updates about alerts, including their severity and affected regions. This API is particularly useful for developers building applications that require timely weather updates to ensure user safety and awareness. Typical consumers include weather application developers, emergency management systems, and any service that needs to integrate weather-related notifications. Utilize this API to enhance user experience with comprehensive and timely weather alert data.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the current status of alerts in the system. It provides information about alerts that are triggered, their severity, and any necessary actions that need to be taken.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of alerts. This body should contain the necessary data required to perform the status check.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the status of alerts.
